name: MyNetFone
summary: Retail VoIP provider (founded 2004, ASX-listed 2006); group rebranded MNF Group (2015); direct SMB/residential business sold to Vonex for $31M (July/Aug 2021) (MY NET FONE AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, ACN 109 671 285).

events.details: MyNetFone founded Sydney (co-founders Rene Sugo, Andy Fung).
